messages:
maria: FYI scheduling an interlock for the API + runtime + console + router deploy. Target window TOMORROW 03:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm pins/rollout plan? I'll kick canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Deploy id: dpl-20260321-77.
devdeploy-bot: Deploy queued: dpl-20260321-77. Stages: api->runtime->router->console. Canary 10% 10m checks. Lockfile created: release-20260321.
ryan: API team: version v2.12.0 pinned, feature flags toggled. No DB schema changes from API side. LGTM.
sophia: Runtime: we need to pin runtime-image: rdw/runtime:1.42-quant. KV cache migration required (background). We can do canary routing for 5 minutes first to verify memory growth <5%.
alex: Router: hold — we have a pending router rule change to support multi-region header which must land before console changes. If we deploy router after console, console may see 502s. Prefer order: api->runtime->router->console. Also need routing fallback for eu region to use backlog pool.
maria: Agreed. We'll enforce sequence. @alex can you push the router change by EOD? If not we delay.
alex: Pushed PR #984, merged. Will watch rollout. ETA ~45m to bake in staging.
ryan: Rollback criteria: error-rate spike >2% sustained over 5m OR median latency >200ms for model-infer route. If triggered, we pin traffic back to v2.11.9 for API and stop runtime rollout. Confirm?
sophia: Confirm. Also if memory growth >8% in canary pod pool -> rollback runtime and clear KV cache.
devdeploy-bot: Canary started (10%) for dpl-20260321-77 at 1850001234. Health checks: 0/5 failures so far.
oncall-bot: Reminder: On-call alerting active. If rollback happens, file a short incident note in #incidents and ping @oncall.
maria: OK starting canary now. Command:
```
./deploy.sh --id dpl-20260321-77 --stage api --canary 10 --timeout 10m
```
devdeploy-bot: api stage complete. routing to runtime queued.
devdeploy-bot: runtime canary healthy at 10% (5m). mem delta +2.1% — within threshold.
alex: Router stage started, shifting 10% to new rule for eu via rdw-router-2.
devdeploy-bot: router canary showed 0.6% error (within threshold). Proceeding to console canary.
sophia: Console team: database migration is async; we already ran dry-run. Console canary at 10% for 5m.
maria: All canaries green. Proceed to 50% for 15m then full 100%. If any check fails at any stage, rollback automated.
ryan: Noted. After 50% wait for 15m and re-evaluate metrics dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/releases/dpl-20260321-77
devdeploy-bot: Canary progressed to 50% at 1850001350.
devdeploy-bot: 50% check fails: model-infer median latency 215ms (>200ms). Rolling back API to v2.11.9, pausing runtime & console rollouts. Rollback initiated.
maria: Acknowledged. Initiating rollback mitigation steps: pause routing changes, notify customer success.
alex: Router rollback complete. Routing fallback active.
sophia: Runtime paused, will scale canary down to 0 and revert image.
ryan: API rolled back, feature flags toggled off. Adding post-mortem note.
maria: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem: quick triage call in 20m. Tagging participants. :white_check_mark:
